properties.title: Towards Suturing World Models: Learning Predictive Models for Robotic Surgical Tasks

properties.version_basis: arXiv v1 PDF identified by SHA-256; later versions not compared.

properties.description: Fine-tuning of two open-source latent video diffusion models on 1,836 annotated robotic suturing clips, with loss and latency comparison.
